claims.claim: Exact certificate characterization: G contains K6 minus an edge as an induced minor exactly when it has six pairwise-disjoint nonempty connected vertex sets A,B,C1,C2,C3,C4 such that A and B are anticomplete and every other pair of sets has an edge between it. Consequently detection is in NP and has an O(7^n n²) exact algorithm.
claims.evidence: After deleting unused vertices, the inverse images of vertices under contractions are disjoint nonempty connected branch sets. Adjacency between two contracted vertices exists exactly when an original edge joins their branch sets, so the unique missing target edge is equivalent to A and B being anticomplete and all fourteen other pairs being adjacent. Conversely, deleting vertices outside six such sets and contracting a spanning tree in each produces exactly K6 minus an edge. A seven-label assignment is an O(n)-size certificate; nonemptiness, connectivity, forbidden adjacency, and required adjacencies are checkable in O(n²). Enumerating all 7^n assignments therefore gives the stated bound. The checker independently evaluated every 6! singleton labeling on all 32,768 six-vertex graphs and accepted exactly the fifteen labeled copies of K6 minus an edge.
claims.search_method: Reconstructed both directions directly from vertex deletion and edge contraction; supplemented this with exhaustive exact-integer enumeration of all six-vertex graphs.

claims.claim: Let q be the number of nonedges of G. Detection is fixed-parameter tractable in q, in time O(7^(2q+3)n²), and undecided instances have at most 2q+3 vertices. In particular, the problem is polynomial-time solvable when q=O(log n).
claims.evidence: If q=0, every two nonempty disjoint sets have an edge between them, so the required anticomplete pair cannot exist. If q>0 and four universal vertices exist, the endpoints of any nonedge together with those four vertices induce K6 minus precisely that edge. Otherwise there are at most three universal vertices. Every other vertex is an endpoint of at least one of the q nonedges, so there are at most 2q such vertices and n≤2q+3. Applying claim 0's algorithm only in this residual case gives O(7^(2q+3)n²), which is FPT in q and polynomial when q≤C log n for a constant C. Exhaustive testing of all 2,131,019 labeled graphs on at most seven vertices found no failure of either preprocessing rule or the residual size inequality.
claims.search_method: Proved the endpoint-count bound and both preprocessing cases directly, then exhaustively checked every labeled graph through seven vertices using integer bitsets.

claims.claim: On chordal graphs, K6 minus an edge is an induced minor if and only if it is already an induced subgraph. Thus chordal inputs can be decided in O(n^6) time by enumerating six vertices. The same argument works for Kt minus an edge for every fixed t≥3.
claims.evidence: Restrict to the union of a branch model; this remains chordal. The four core branches give four A–B paths with pairwise-disjoint interiors. Hence every A–B separator disjoint from A∪B has size at least four. For an inclusion-minimal such separator S, the A- and B-side components are full to S. If two vertices of S were nonadjacent, shortest paths between them through the two full components would combine into an induced cycle of length at least four, so S is a clique. In either full component D, choose v maximizing |N(v)∩S|. If v misses s∈S, take a shortest path from v to a vertex p adjacent to s. For each t∈N(v)∩S, chordality of the cycle formed by t, the relevant path suffix, s, and the clique edge st forces tp; thus p has all those neighbors plus s, contradicting maximality. Therefore each side contains an S-complete vertex. Those two nonadjacent vertices and any four vertices of S induce K6 minus an edge. Replacing four by t−2 proves the fixed-t statement. Enumerating six-vertex subsets gives O(n^6). An exhaustive check of all 636,723 chordal labeled graphs on at most seven vertices found no contraction-only K6-minus-edge model.
claims.search_method: Completed the minimal-separator proof from first principles and exhaustively compared induced-subgraph and definition-level induced-minor predicates on all chordal graphs through seven vertices.

claims.claim: There is an explicit polynomial-time classification on complete multipartite graphs. Let the part sizes be n1,…,nr. For every i with ni≥2, reserve two vertices of part i and put mi=ni−2 and mj=nj for j≠i. Accept exactly when, for some s∈{0,…,4} and some s distinct indices J⊆{1,…,r}\{i}, subtracting one from each mj with j∈J leaves counts whose complete multipartite graph has a matching of size at least 4−s. If the residual total is M and its largest part has size L, this matching size is min(⌊M/2⌋,M−L).
claims.evidence: Anticompleteness forces every vertex of the two exceptional branches into one common multipartite part. Since that part is independent and each branch is connected, both branches are singletons. Every core branch is then either a singleton in an outside part or spans at least two parts. Singleton cores must occupy distinct outside parts. A spanning core can be reduced to one cross-part edge: such an edge remains adjacent to both exceptional vertices, every outside-part singleton core, and every other cross-part edge. Thus, after selecting s singleton-core parts, the remaining 4−s cores exist exactly when the residual multipartite graph has a matching of that size. Any matching has size at most ⌊M/2⌋ and at most M−L; if L>M/2, pair every outside vertex with a largest-part vertex, while if L≤M/2, repeatedly pairing vertices from two largest remaining parts gives ⌊M/2⌋ edges. Hence the formula and classification are exact. A definition-level exhaustive branch-set search agreed with the criterion on all 138 multipartite part-size profiles totaling at most ten vertices; an independent matching recurrence also agreed with the formula on every profile.
claims.search_method: Derived necessary and sufficient branch-set normal form without assuming the criterion, then compared the criterion against exhaustive connected-subset search and exact bitmask matching on all small part profiles.

claims.claim: Given a tree decomposition of width w, detection is decidable in n·2^{O(w log w)} time; hence it is polynomial-time solvable on every fixed-width class supplied with such decompositions.
claims.evidence: On a nice edge-introducing decomposition, record the seven-way bag labeling, the connectivity partition induced by each selected label, a three-way unseen/active/completed phase per label, and fourteen required-adjacency bits. Same-label edges merge partition blocks; required cross-label edges set bits; an A–B edge rejects. When forgetting the last bag vertex of a block, separator locality prevents that block from connecting to future vertices, so the transition is legal only when it is the label's sole block, after which the label is closed. Join nodes take transitive closure of the two child partitions, OR adjacency bits, and reject incompatible phases. The empty-root condition enforces six nonempty connected branches and all required adjacencies. For bag size b≤w+1 there are at most 7^b·Bell(b)·3^6·2^14 states. Since Bell(b)≤b^b, this is 2^{O(w log w)}; even pairwise join processing preserves that bound. A standard nice decomposition has O(n) nodes up to factors absorbed by the stated parameter term. The exact-integer checker independently computed the Bell recurrence and state bounds through bag size 32.
claims.search_method: Audited the complete connectivity-state invariant, forget and join locality, root condition, and asymptotic state count; supplemented it with exact Bell-number arithmetic.

claims.claim: A model cannot in general be normalized so that either endpoint of the missing edge has a singleton branch set. A 12-vertex counterexample consists of anticomplete paths A=a1a2a3a4 and B=b1b2b3b4, a clique C={c1,c2,c3,c4}, and exactly the additional edges aici and bici for i=1,…,4.
claims.evidence: The two four-vertex paths and the four singleton ci sets form the displayed model. If an exceptional branch were {x}, its four disjoint core neighbors would require four distinct neighbors of x. Every path vertex has degree at most three, so x=ci. The other exceptional branch must be a connected interval in one component of A−ai or B−bi. Up to swapping paths and reversing indices, x is c1 or c2. For c2 every allowable interval has fewer than four external neighbors. For c1, only {a2,a3} and {a2,a3,a4} have four external neighbors. Four disjoint core branches must use all four boundary vertices, including a1; but a1 is isolated after x and that interval are removed, so its core branch would be {a1}, anticomplete to the other cores. This is impossible. Symmetry covers all ci and either exceptional endpoint. The exhaustive checker validated the displayed model, enumerated 1,264 ordered singleton/connected-other exceptional pairs and every compatible connected core candidate, and found zero singleton-exception models.
claims.witness: The graph has path edges a1a2,a2a3,a3a4 and b1b2,b2b3,b3b4; all six edges among c1,c2,c3,c4; spokes aici and bici for i=1,2,3,4; and no other edges. Its valid model is (A,B,{c1},{c2},{c3},{c4}), while no model has a singleton exceptional branch.
claims.search_method: Proved the degree, interval, boundary, and isolation obstructions, then exhaustively enumerated every connected branch-set possibility using exact integer bitsets.

target_evidence: The exact target requests an unrestricted complexity classification for detecting K6 minus an edge as an induced minor, together with a polynomial-time algorithm if the problem is tractable. The draft does not establish either an unrestricted polynomial-time algorithm or an unrestricted hardness result, and its final writeup explicitly says that the unrestricted P-versus-NP-complete classification remains unresolved. It therefore does not fully resolve the target. The verified certificate characterization, dense-graph parameterization, chordal and complete-multipartite classifications, bounded-treewidth algorithm, and normalization obstruction are nevertheless correct and material partial progress. Because the draft labels its resolution as PARTIAL and does not claim unrestricted coverage, claimed_resolution is ACCURATE rather than overstated or understated.
